spec: I have a Verilog module that performs signed division. I need to modify it to add a post-processing scaling stage before the output register to handle large magnitudes. Implement `ECO-friendly` magnitude detection: high_mag is true if any bit in abs_res[15:12] is 1; mid_mag is true if any bit in abs_res[15:8] is 1. Create a scaled_res signal using arithmetic shifts to avoid multipliers: if high_mag is true, scale by 0.75 (x - (x >>> 2)); else if mid_mag is true, scale by 0.875 (x - (x >>> 3)); otherwise pass the result through. Register scaled_res into output y. Keep the interface the same. Use as few signal/reg/wire declarations as possible.
